:::{#def-conditional-entropy}
#### Conditional entropy

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-entropy, write $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$.
The **conditional entropy** of $Y$ given $X$
averages the [entropy of $Y$ given each value of $X$](#def-entropy-given-value)
over the distribution of $X$:

$$H(Y \mid X) \eqdef \sum_{x} p(x) \, H(Y \mid X=x),$$

where the sum runs over the values $x$ with $p(x) > 0$.

:::
